summary: This bill provides an automatic appropriation for the salaries and expenses of most Bureau of Prisons staff during periods when regular appropriations for fiscal years 2026 or 2027 are not in effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill ensures the continued payment of salaries and expenses for the Bureau of Prisons staff during appropriations gaps. This directly supports the functioning of the federal correctional system, which is a core component of criminal justice, by maintaining its operational capacity.
